symptom: `if $Item != empty and Module.Rule(S = $Item/Name) then` passed check; exec wrote the condition as expression text and mx check failed CE0117 "Error(s) in expression." at the decision.
cause: MDL066 (qualified call in an expression) exempted the whole IF condition, because a rule call there becomes a RuleSplitCondition. That holds only when the call IS the condition; combined with and/or/not it is plain expression text.
fix: The IF condition is exempt only when, parentheses aside, it is one qualified call (and then only its arguments are judged); any other condition is walked like every value position.
insight: An exemption granted to a position should be granted to a shape: 'the decision condition' was the legal home only for the call that fills it entirely. unwrapParenCall is the builder's own test for that shape, so check and exec now agree by construction.
test: mdl/executor/validate_qualified_call_in_condition_2625_test.go (combined and `not` flagged; whole and parenthesized not); failed before the fix. Live 11.12.6: combined form CE0117 under --no-check and refused by check; whole condition 0 errors.
